name: promo-dialog
title: Promo dialog
description: The loudest surface: a centred dialog, or a split image-and-copy layout for launches. A swipe-down sheet on phones. Full-screen stories plug in with the pro promo-story add-on.
docs: Requires Base UI 1.8+ (a base-* shadcn project): the phone layout uses the Base UI Drawer for swipe dismissal.
